title: Why Ryu never knew his parents in Street Fighter
subject: ryu
description:
Who do you think Ryu's parents were? 👇

How an orphan raised by Gouken became the most famous fighter in Street Fighter, and lost his master. Spoilers for the Street Fighter series.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Capcom. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Ryu grew up with no memory of his mother or father.
A master named Gouken took the orphan in and raised him at a mountain dojo in Japan.
Gouken taught him Ansatsuken, an assassin's art, minus its darkest techniques.
Then a spoiled American kid named Ken arrived, and Ryu got a brother and a rival.
At 23, Ryu won the first World Warrior tournament by beating the champion, Sagat.
He came home to a silent dojo. Gouken had been killed by his own brother, Akuma.
Ryu has wandered ever since, asking what his fists are really for.
